kind: SYNTHETIC timing estimates (no real data, no labels); real views may converge differently (MLP early stopping); one process under cbp.sema, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; cpu_s = process CPU time of the measuring process
fixture: cbp.audit.synthetic_D (OSF_DEFENSE_FIT 15,434 / AUDIT_FIT 6,065 / INNER_SELECTION 2,235 / assessment 13,936 rows, P(S=1) = 0.68) + synthetic_release (income 8 per class x 2, occupation m2 per class x 5 predicted classes + 1 reserved token; SEX-tilted 10%); FINAL slate (LR x5, MLP x4, HGB x4, DA_LR, DA_MLP) + cell readers {0.5, 1, 5}; the AUC- and CE-selected attackers refit at attacker seeds 0-2; a temporary cbp-named unit store with the registered 38-code composition bank (real registration and closure checks)

registered_control_limits.null: every view: held-out AUC_B <= 0.5 + 3.5 sd0 (sd0 = Mann-Whitney null sd on half B)
registered_control_limits.XOR: AUC_B(pair) > 0.75 and AUC_B(v1) <= null threshold and AUC_B(v2) <= null threshold
registered_control_limits.ROT_r1_ROT_r2: AUC_B(v_i) > 0.75 and AUC_B(pair) > 0.75 and serialisation exact
registered_control_limits.null_calibration: 5 permutations (seed CONTROL_SEED + 100 + rep); pass iff no exceedance of 0.5 + 3.5 sd0
registered_control_limits.realised_threshold_rule: the realised null threshold must equal the source's within 1e-12 (fixed split and permutation seeds on the same roles); otherwise a technical failure
registered_control_limits.plants_in_candidate_bank: never (in-memory / temporary-directory releases, never saved as units)

bank.codes_note: 27 registered codes per seed: DIRECT-TASK i8o64, FINE-TASK i8o64, CLASS-ONLY i1o1, 24 privacy codes (6 lambdas x LOCAL / SEQ-12 / SEQ-21 / JOINT) at i8o64
bank.composition_only_note: the 11 COMPOSED_EXTRA qpc public maps (inner-audited, never selection candidates); i4oX is costed at the measured i8oX (one more income state per class; slightly conservative)

assessment.note: about 20 locked labels per seed (lead): ~15 codes (P*, J*, T*, C_rate, C_global, Q, CLASS, source JOINT / SEQ-12 / SEQ-21 0.1, no-headroom winner, per-family headroom winners; aliases deduplicated), SRC|U, SRC|RAW-J, E, F, F0. SRC|U is costed with ALL 38 composition codes as composed readers (upper bound; the freeze list alone is smaller)

estimates.assessment_basis: per seed: 15 codes x one family at the i8o64 cost; both sources' five own families; SRC|U composed with all 38 composition codes (each composed code's bank fitted once per unit and shared across the four composing families by the content memo; cost scaled by its inner cost); E / F / F0 at the five-family source cost plus one cells family each for F / F0
estimates.safety_note: synthetic MLP early stopping converges fast; qpc's synthetic estimate (4.05 CPU-h with x2) against ~2 CPU-h measured for its real study workers suggests the raw estimate is already conservative; the x2 margin is the scheduling budget
